# mxroute_domain_pointers (Data Source)

List pointers for an owned domain. An unavailable parent produces an error, not an empty list. Mock-tested alpha; runtime API behavior remains live-unverified.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mxroute_domain_pointers" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Canonical owned domain name.
